Hi Irene and James,

Thanks for the heads up — we can proceed with a private offer for NovusAI. A few items from the Marketplace side: 

- Private Offer ID: PO-AWS-892761 (create in our system once seller initiates).
- Invoicing: We can configure the private offer so that Amazon invoices NovusAI directly (Novus will receive invoices from AWS). If you prefer Redwood to invoice, select the alternate billing flow when creating the offer.
- PO acceptance: Once Novus issues a PO referencing PO-AWS-892761 and uploads it to AWS (or emails it per your internal process), the offer will be accepted and billing will be routed as configured.
- Timeline: We can turn the offer live within 3 business days after the PO is accepted. Expect the private offer link and seller terms after Irene submits the private offer request.

Please find attached our quick instructions for private offer acceptance and examples of the PO language we recommend. If you'd like, I can schedule a 30-min call with finance/procurement to walk through the acceptance steps.
